[[File:2602.png|right]] 26.02 ==The Potato Fields== Region: the Grey Mountains

Connects to: 25.04 and 26.01.

==Overview==

The only thing that keeps the orcish warriors fed are the fields of potatoes that ring Hoth Achaar ([[26.01]]), which grow great yields even in the stony mountain soil (see [[Orcs#Potatoes|the significance of potatoes to the orcs]]).
